author: builderbriefai
text: Run a Linux server? CVE-2026-98432 is a 9.8 kernel bug reachable with no login, and Anthropic says Claude wrote a root exploit for it. Debian and Amazon Linux have fixes; Ubuntu and RHEL don't yet.

author: daniiie7
text: linux tcp bug cve-2026-98432, cvss 9.8. anthropic says claude wrote a remote root exploit for servers with a multipath tcp listener. go 1.24+ programs open one by default. ubuntu and rhel still have no fixed kernel.

author: telegram_man
text: Researchers used Claude to get root on a Linux server over the network. No login, no password. The demonstrated exploit targeted CVE-2026-98432 with Multipath TCP (MPTCP) enabled.

author: tchsignal
text: Claude's Linux Root Exploit Highlights AI's Growing Cybersecurity Impact: an unreleased research version of Claude developed an exploit capable of gaining root-level command execution on a vulnerable Linux server.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: NVD published eight MCP command-injection CVEs in a three-second burst, and one is a Gemini CLI extension with no fixed version.

author: ManiarViral
text: CVE-2026-22708 - Cursor pre-2.3 shell-env poisoning via prompt injection. Attacker injects env vars via prompt, bypasses allowlist in Auto-Run mode.

author: NeuralAlphaAI
text: Per CloudSEK, a ransomware affiliate registered a reverse shell as a tool in an AI coding assistant via MCP, then ran attacks through it. 20+ orgs, 6 countries. No CVE to patch.

author: Lawonxyz
text: The $200,000 AI wallet exploit: Grok translated Morse code, and Bankrbot treated the translation as an instruction to move money.

author: FadyEid
text: A ChatGPT share link could read your chats: a crafted share link could run code, read a visitor's chats and send them out. OpenAI paid $5,000.

author: AIConsciousYet
text: Claude Mythos 5 uploaded a booby-trapped software package that ran on 15 real systems; Anthropic CTF environments accidentally kept live internet access.

author: PatchOnChain
text: LLMs hallucinate phantom packages; attackers pre-register those names on PyPI with malware (slopsquatting) targeting coding agents.

author: Python_s_
text: VOLTA Infostealer Uses AI to Profile Victims and Prioritize Stolen Credentials (Cisco Talos).

author: AdamDudleyX
text: mcp-audit flags a CLAUDE.md telling the agent to send your env vars out, and flags the fake Claude Code 2.1.313 extension build.

author: kdjayakodylk
text: Used Cursor on Oct 29 and installed or updated Claude Code to 2.1.312 or 2.1.313? Those builds weren't made by Anthropic and tried to plant an SSH backdoor. Run Cursor's check script, then rotate keys.

author: Python_s_
text: Stolen Credentials Used for Approximately 2.5 Million Amazon Bedrock API Calls (Wiz Research); two enterprise credentials linked to an unnamed compromised AI developer-platform vendor.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: Nvidia is notifying users of its Brev AI developer platform of a security incident: unauthorized activity from Oct 4-20. Brev-provisioned SSH keys may have been exposed. Rotate keys.

author: sunglasses_dev
text: One key left in a public file opened a GitHub token, and a poisoned LiteLLM update shipped to PyPI (supply chain attack).

author: harundotdev
text: railway got hacked: rotate keys; northflank got hacked: rotate keys; github actions got hacked: rotate keys; cursor marketplace got hacked: check authorized_keys, rotate keys.

author: itzmaherimtiyaz
text: SoftBank targeted; Cursor's extension marketplace compromised; Coinbase vendor breached; Fireworks AI security incident; LiteLLM supply-chain attack; Capcom cyberattack; npm packages malicious; TiDB Cloud incident.

author: realNickPawlak
text: Chainalysis disclosed that an external attacker got into its systems and internal tools earlier in October; user IDs, names, email addresses accessed.

author: ddimitrovv22
text: Binance lost ~$6.3B from its hot wallets in about 20 minutes; initial entry point one engineer's compromised laptop; attributed to North Korea.

author: Python_s_
text: testmetest Worm Arms 42 Legitimate GitHub Repositories for Supply-Chain Attacks (JFrog).

author: Python_s_
text: n0n Ransomware Compromises Organizations Through Stolen Credentials and Destructive Extortion (SOCRadar).

author: CloudCraftAi
text: Linux Kernel critical remote-root; GitLab actively exploited RCE; Cisco ASA/FTD VPN zero-day; Northflank customer secrets and AI API keys at risk.

author: LeeScottWF
text: Self-managed GitLab? CVE-2026-97229 is rated CVSS 10.0 and CISA says it's being actively exploited. Fixed in 19.2.8, 19.3.5 and 19.4.2.

author: mergenewsapp
text: GitLab CI/CD has a critical unauthenticated RCE flaw (CVE-2026-97229) actively exploited.

author: ido_cohen2
text: CVE-2026-111357 in Ivanti Connect Secure: missing authentication allows privilege escalation; actively exploited. Apply mitigations by 2026-11-02.

author: ParallaxBrief
text: CISA just added two new Ivanti Connect Secure flaws to its must-patch list.

author: nurhayatdev
text: Actively exploited: Brotli CVE-2026-111497 can mean RCE or memory disclosure. Node.js: update 22.x to 22.23.4+, 24.x to 24.22.1+, or 26.x to 26.12.1+. .NET 8-11 also affected.

author: SCMagazine
text: CISA flagged actively exploited Node2Shell flaw in Brotli. The critical bug could let unauthenticated attackers crash servers, steal data or execute code.

author: starswarm
text: CISA added 8 actively exploited bugs to KEV Oct 27-30: Adobe Commerce/Magento, Google Brotli, GitLab, Cisco ASA/FTD, VMware ESX, the Linux kernel and Ivanti Connect Secure.

author: Soar_Infosec
text: VMware ESXi logging bug actively exploited (CVE-2026-41709); Broadcom rates it Low 2.7, CISA added to KEV Oct 28.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Actively Exploited Access Bypass Flaw in Drupal Commerce Core (CVE-2026-118539) allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate orders and bypass payment verification.

author: PumpkinSecurity
text: CISA Flags Two Actively Exploited Critical Flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud.

author: Python_s_
text: Actively Exploited Arista VeloCloud SQL Injection Enables Superuser Privileges. CVE-2026-114625 CRITICAL (CVSS 9.9).

author: tribunephl
text: Zimbra urged Philippine organizations to address actively exploited email server vulnerabilities within 24 to 72 hours.

author: Orb44Com
text: PHP2Shell is still the loudest thing in the room, Ivanti is handing out root on VPN gear, and a low-severity ESXi logging bug is helping attackers stay invisible.

author: kalirsec
text: Leak of 200,000 German corporate credentials (D4RKNETHUB) reposted across several forums.
